messages.subject: Shimazdu
parts:
Hello everyone,
I have some .ibd/.imzML files generated with Shimadzu imzML Converter version 1.21.0.11302.

Trying to read them with Cardinal::readImzML() (Cardinal 3.0.1) generates for some of the files the error 

<simpleError in validObject(.Object): invalid class “MassDataFrame” object: 1: 'mz' must be in increasing order

invalid class “MassDataFrame” object: 2: elements of 'mz' must be unique>


The problem is reproducable but occures only in some of the files. The problem is independent from the file size. 


Has anyone experience with this or similar issues?


Thanks for any help


Cheers, Lutz
